cost_drivers.driver: Access from below (opening the ceiling of the space beneath the tub) versus from above
cost_drivers.effect: Bidirectional. The five-plus plumbers who declined the from-above option recommend working from below, which is the conventional fallback but adds ceiling work and possible repair of the storage-unit ceiling.

cost_drivers.driver: Whether the waste and overflow assembly is replaced as a unit or only the linkage and plunger
cost_drivers.effect: Explains most of the $614 vs $550 spread; the $135 quote covers a plunger-handle adjustment only and therefore excludes any wall opening.

cost_drivers.driver: Drywall opening and finish, plus repainting the affected area
cost_drivers.effect: Adds a second trade when the plumbing contractor holds no drywall or general building classification — which is true of all three quoting plumbers.

cost_drivers.driver: DBI permit issuance fee and inspection time
cost_drivers.effect: Adds $290 (Category 1P) plus inspection time if a permit is required for this scope.

cost_drivers.driver: Occupied-unit scheduling — work outside normal business hours or on short notice
cost_drivers.effect: If the work cannot be done during normal business hours, off-hour inspection rates ($555/hour, minimum two hours weekday / four hours weekend) and after-hours labour apply.
cost_drivers.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (DBI fee schedule); applicability depends on the permit decision — see R-P01

cost_drivers.driver: Site conditions inside the unit and inside the storage unit below (clearance, storage contents, power and water access)
